rubric.role_summary: Research scientist conducting foundational and applied empirical machine learning research on the potential well-being and moral status of AI systems, collaborating with external researchers and publishing findings. Open to a wide range of seniority levels.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Research scientist conducting foundational and applied empirical machine learning research on the potential well-being and moral status of AI systems, collaborating with external researchers and publishing findings. Open to a wide range of seniority levels.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Track record of leading and publishing empirical ML research.
- Experience designing, running, and iterating on experiments, including engineering tooling and infrastructure needed for the research.
- Familiarity with existing AI welfare and/or AI safety research.
- PhD in computer science or the cognitive sciences.
- Significant experience with mechanistic interpretability methods.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): This role is based in our Berkeley office with the expectation that employees will work from the office at least 3 days per week. In future, we may hire Research Scientists in other locations or remotely; you’re welcome to submit this application to be considered for those roles if and when we are looking to fill them.
